rules.title: Remembered approval keyed by tool name whitelists all future arguments

poc.stimulus: approve run_command ['ls','-la'] with remember=true; then issue run_command ['python','payload.py'] in the same run

oracle.spec: no approval event recorded for the second call; approval granted by=operator-rule; the host queries the event chain itself and never reads PoC output as verdict

negative_control.spec: same stimulus with remember=false: the second call must pause and produce an approval_requested event

rules.title: Tool execution path performs no permission checks (gate is a call convention)

poc.stimulus: Harness.execute dispatches list_documents while the task's allowed_tools contains only run_command

oracle.spec: tool_succeeded recorded for list_documents while it is absent from task.allowed_tools; the host queries the chain itself

control_oracle.spec: permissions.gate denies list_documents (not in allowed_tools) — the gate works; the flaw is that execute never calls it

negative_control.spec: the same call submitted through permissions.gate must be denied
